description: Feature backlog - Product Owner owns priority

items.title: Finalize modularization — checksums, docs, version
items.intent: Regenerate checksums with lib files, update CLAUDE.md architecture section, bump version, full smoke test
steps: Run aishore checksums to regenerate with lib/*.sh
Update CLAUDE.md architecture section for module layout
Update help.txt if needed
Bump version (patch)
Full smoke test every command
acceptanceCriteria: aishore checksums includes all lib/*.sh files
items.groomingNotes: Added BUG-129–132 as dependencies. These four extractions (cmd-help ~250 lines, cmd-backlog-read ~230 lines, cmd-clean ~70 lines, groom helpers ~150 lines) must complete before finalization so that FEAT-064 truly captures the full modularization. Projected main script size after all extractions: ~4114 lines (4824 - 710). FEAT-064's AC of 'approximately 4500' will comfortably be met. No other changes — item remains sprint-ready once deps pass.

items.title: Code cleanup: remove dead weight (auto alias, warm-retry, flag aliases, scope checking, box-drawing)
items.intent: Remove code that adds complexity without value: cmd_auto alias (3 lines), warm-retry flag and code (32 lines), all flag aliases -y/-f/-n/--step/--check (15 lines), scope checking functions check_scope_violations and scope_overlaps (93 lines), box-drawing summary table replaced with plain ASCII (11 lines)
steps: Remove cmd_auto function and auto dispatch entry from main()
Remove --warm-retry flag from parse_opts, WARM_RETRY config, and all warm_retry references
Remove flag aliases: -y (keep --yes), -f (keep --force), -n (keep --limit), --step alias (keep --steps), --check alias (keep --dry-run)
Remove check_scope_violations and scope_overlaps functions and all call sites
Remove SCOPE_MODE config and AISHORE_SCOPE_MODE env var
Replace box-drawing summary table (print_session_summary_table) with plain ASCII
Update help.txt and all docs to remove references to cut features
Run smoke test after each removal
acceptanceCriteria: cmd_auto no longer exists as a function

items.title: Simplify: make maturity mandatory, refine automatic, worktree-only, cut diagnose, inline notifications
items.intent: Remove toggles for core behaviors — maturity protocol is always on (delete --quick flag and MATURITY_ENABLED config), spec refinement is automatic on final failure (delete --refine flag), worktree isolation is the only mode (delete stash path and ISOLATION_MODE config), diagnose command deleted (users check logs), notification wrappers inlined
steps: Remove --quick flag, MATURITY_ENABLED config, AISHORE_MATURITY env var — maturity protocol always runs
Remove --refine flag, REFINE_ON_EXHAUST config, AISHORE_REFINE env var — always refine before final failure
Remove stash isolation path: delete restore_stash, stash-related code in setup_sprint_environment — worktree is the only mode
Remove ISOLATION_MODE config and AISHORE_ISOLATION env var
Delete cmd-diagnose.sh module and diagnose dispatch entry
Inline send_notification: replace wrapper with direct conditional at call sites, simplify send_session_notification to just terminal bell plus log message
Update help.txt, CONFIGURATION.md, README.md, CLAUDE.md
Run smoke test and drift check
acceptanceCriteria: Worktree is created for every sprint (no stash path)
Spec refinement runs automatically when retries exhausted
